title: SONIC PICO PARK (TECOPARK / PICO PARK Inc., with SEGA), a 2-8 player co-op puzzle game, launched Thu 12 Nov 2026 on PS5, Xbox Series X|S, Xbox One, Switch 2, Switch and PC; ₹649 on Steam India; online cross-play; Steam Remote Play Together lets one owner stream local co-op to up to 4 players (more on fast connections).
